findings.title: Real signal adapter can reacquire a reaped N number or use stale group identity during recovery
Held no-N/no-birth startup still cannot reconcile a late genuine C close
Positive pilot exception path returns while cleanup is unknown instead of owning a terminal finally
Typed reporting boundary exists but actual CLI/default stderr bypasses it
Unknown original C epoch observation is treated as gone in shared proof
Expected-fault gate accepts unrelated settlement failure and does not bind live observation to the same N epoch
Persistent owner is registered after start, and the exceptional finally never completes cleanup
Original cancel error is replaced, arbitrary failure can qualify as expected, and held recovery drops the raw outcome
Known PID is mistaken for same live N epoch when injecting the deliberate fault
Reporting boundary is unused and does not guard the actual CLI stderr writes
No-birth and pre-authorisation held failures cannot reconcile even after real close becomes available
Legacy wrapper retarget still self-pins current C, substitutes Host group count and treats timeout as runner close
Read-only receipt snapshots destructively finalize hashes and break every normal positive proof
The nofork pilot still declares cleanup complete after timeout and lacks asynchronous startup ownership
Real writable wait references a nonexistent custodian field
Resource-ended proof still rejects legitimate failed startup and cannot reconcile preHELLO failures
Unknown N identity can skip escalation and make a live TERM-ignore domain unrecoverable
Matching digests/counts still do not validate actual wait/identity semantics
Diagnostic accounting stops as soon as settlement begins
Identity budget failure becomes an irreversible responsibility hold even after all children end
Adopted TERM-ignore helper still has no ready/liveness barrier before leader leaves
普通拒绝及真实失败拿不到完整阶段凭证，永久占住 whole-production scope
原生成功但 tree release 失败仍提前 reject，绕过原 promise barrier
reconcile 把 release 的幂等 no-op 当 fresh tree 结束证明
direct bridge 的 handle 在 await 获准后创建，未进入可恢复 map
